raw_metadata.abstract_snippet: This study evaluated 12,000 AI-designed CAR-T binders targeting CD20. Researchers identified 707 binders that enhanced T cell function, revealing design principles to improve future AI binder development. The findings offer practical recommendations and an open dataset for AI-driven binder design.

raw_metadata.authors: Elizabeth Hogben; Anna Schurich; Charlotte Graham
raw_metadata.abstract_snippet: CAR T cell therapies show promise for cancer treatment but can cause severe toxicities like cytokine release syndrome. Researchers are developing engineering strategies to balance potent anti-cancer activity with reduced side effects. These approaches aim to improve the safety and efficacy of CAR T cell treatments.
